name: ISACA San Diego Chapter
description: Local chapter of ISACA serving IS audit, risk, governance and security professionals in San Diego County. Runs monthly lunchtime chapter meetings, joint evening events with CSA and ISSA, and community events such as the disc golf outing.
usual_cadence_text: Monthly chapter meeting, typically the third Thursday at lunch (12:00 to 1:15 PM), hybrid in person and Zoom; plus joint evening events with CSA/ISSA and periodic coffee talks
default_venue: Rotates; recent meetings at XiFin, Inc., 12225 El Camino Real (Carmel Valley) and joint events at KPMG, 4655 Executive Dr (UTC). Earlier meetings at National University Spectrum campus (Kearny Mesa)
cost_notes: Not published on the events page; past chapter meetings have been free or low cost for members. Verify per event on Eventbrite.
cpe_notes: Chapter meetings carry ISACA CPE (1 CPE for a 75 minute lunch meeting in a past listing). ISACA also accepts CPE from other chapters' educational events.
notes: Events are published on isaca-sd.org/events and registered through Eventbrite (organizer: ISACA San Diego Chapter). The ISACA Engage calendar (engage.isaca.org/sandiegochapter) is often empty and should not be the source of truth. Contact is via web form only; no public email found. The chapter's about page states third Thursday, but October 2026 shows a Friday Oct 23 lunch meeting, so the rule is a default, not a guarantee. Co-organizer of San Diego CyberCon.

name: ISSA San Diego Chapter
description: San Diego chapter of the Information Systems Security Association. Hosts lunch and dinner chapter meetings with speakers and panels, a monthly InfoSec networking happy hour, and joint quarterly mixers with the other local chapters.
usual_cadence_text: Roughly monthly chapter meeting, usually a Thursday lunch (11:30 AM to 1:00 PM) or evening panel, plus a monthly happy hour on a Wednesday or Thursday evening; busiest September through December
default_venue: KPMG LLP, First Floor Training Room, 4655 Executive Dr Suite 1100 (UTC) for meetings; happy hours rotate among Karl Strauss Scranton Rd (Sorrento Mesa), Coronado Brewing Bay Park, Eureka! UTC; mixers at AleSmith Brewing (Miramar)
cost_notes: Name your own price on Luma with suggested tiers: General Admission, discounted Cyber Students and Unemployed tier, SD ISSA Member tier, and a one time First Happy Hour Free waiver. ISSA membership includes chapter events at no charge.
cpe_notes: Not stated on event pages; ISSA chapter meetings are generally self reported CPE for CISSP and similar. Confirm per event.
notes: Primary feed is Luma (luma.com/sdissa, calendar named 'San Diego Cybersecurity Community Events Curated by SD ISSA'), which also lists partner events such as FutureCon and San Diego CyberCon. Secondary Meetup group: meetup.com/san-diego-chapter-issa (179 members, organizer David Petko). Ticket Tailor is used for sponsor packages. Role based emails on the board page (president@, program@, membership@, sponsorship@sdissa.org). Luma calendar ID could not be resolved from the server, so the iCal URL needs to be captured from the Subscribe button in a browser.

name: OWASP San Diego Chapter
description: Local chapter of the Open Worldwide Application Security Project focused on software and application security. Holds a monthly evening meeting with a technical talk and co-hosts the quarterly San Diego cybersecurity mixer.
usual_cadence_text: Monthly, every third Thursday, 6:00 to 8:00 PM
default_venue: Loma Hall, University of San Diego, 5998 Alcala Park (Linda Vista)
cost_notes: Free; OWASP chapter meetings do not charge admission.
cpe_notes: Not stated; typically self reported CPE for ISC2 and ISACA holders.
notes: Meetup group has 2,630 members and recurring Monthly Meeting events scheduled through August 2027 with a working iCal feed. OWASP Foundation announced retirement of its Meetup platform effective January 31, 2026, but this group was still live and populated as of October 2026, so check periodically whether meetings migrate to the new owasp.org chapter calendar. The owasp.org chapter page itself was empty when fetched. Also runs a Slack channel and occasional lockpicking socials at AleSmith.

name: IIA San Diego Chapter
description: San Diego chapter (Chapter 52) of the Institute of Internal Auditors. Offers in person and virtual CPE sessions, a Chief Audit Executive roundtable, and an annual awards luncheon for internal audit professionals.
usual_cadence_text: Irregular; chapter page lists events as they are scheduled and asks visitors to check back
cost_notes: Varies by event; registration through Cvent.
cpe_notes: Events carry IIA CPE; chapter also offers CPE credit to volunteers.
notes: Registration platform is Cvent and historically Aventri (eventscloud). The chapter page in October 2026 was promoting other California chapters' events (Auditor Training Week in Sacramento, Heading Into 2027 in Los Angeles) rather than local ones, so local cadence is unverified. Past local events include a CAE Roundtable (March 2024) and an annual award luncheon. Co-presents the national ISACA and IIA GRC Conference, held in Chula Vista August 17 to 19, 2026.

name: IAPP San Diego KnowledgeNet Chapter
description: Local IAPP KnowledgeNet chapter for privacy professionals in San Diego, chaired by Gaurav Dhiman and Chelsea Rissmiller with associate chair Emerson Bello of the University of San Diego. Meetings are open to IAPP members.
usual_cadence_text: Irregular; no meetings were scheduled as of October 2026
cost_notes: IAPP membership required to join the chapter; KnowledgeNet meetings are normally free to members.
cpe_notes: KnowledgeNet meetings normally qualify for IAPP CPE toward CIPP, CIPM, CIPT and AIGP.
notes: Chapter page stated 'There are currently no meetings scheduled for this chapter.' Past collaborative events include a June 2023 joint IAPP and ISACA San Diego privacy meeting. Treat as low activity until a meeting appears. IAPP's national Privacy. Security. Risk. conference was in Seattle in 2026, not San Diego.

name: ISC2 San Diego Chapter
description: Local ISC2 chapter open to anyone, not only certificate holders. Holds a monthly evening meeting with a guest speaker, hybrid in person at the University of San Diego and on Zoom.
usual_cadence_text: Monthly, second Thursday, 6:00 to 8:00 PM, hybrid
default_venue: University of San Diego, Belanich Engineering Center (Loma Hall) Room BEC-318, 4998 Alcala Park (Linda Vista)
cost_notes: Free; meetings and presentations are no fee.
cpe_notes: ISC2 CPE available; attendees sign in with their ISC2 ID and the attendance phrase announced at the end of the meeting.
notes: Attendance is tracked through a Google Form, not Eventbrite or Meetup. No public email; social presence is Facebook (facebook.com/ISC2SD), a Facebook group, and X (@ISC2SD). All nine 2026 meetings listed fell on the second Thursday. Co-organizer of San Diego CyberCon and records CPE at that event. The old community.isc2.org chapter threads now redirect to isc2chapters.isc2.org.

name: InfraGard San Diego Members Alliance
description: FBI affiliated nonprofit partnership between private sector critical infrastructure stakeholders and the FBI San Diego field office. Runs an annual Cyber Futures Symposium, sector briefings, and a K-12 cybersecurity bootcamp.
usual_cadence_text: Annual Cyber Futures Symposium in late September or early October, plus irregular briefings
default_venue: Rotates: Qualcomm campus, 6455 Lusk Blvd (Sorrento Valley) in 2026; Joan B. Kroc Institute at University of San Diego in 2025
cost_notes: Symposium is ticketed through Eventbrite; price not captured. InfraGard membership requires an FBI background check and is free.
cpe_notes: Not stated on the Eventbrite listings; self report.
notes: Events are registered on Eventbrite (organizer: InfraGard San Diego). 2026 Cyber Futures Symposium was Tuesday September 22, 2026 at Qualcomm; 2025 edition was October 7 at USD. The infragardsd.org events page failed to load during research, so the website calendar is unverified. ISACA San Diego hosted an InfraGard partnership talk in September 2026. Membership details on the site are sparse.

name: Cloud Security Alliance San Diego Chapter
description: Official CSA chapter for San Diego covering cloud, identity and AI security topics. Holds a monthly evening meeting with a sponsored speaker and co-hosts joint events with ISACA and ISSA San Diego.
usual_cadence_text: Monthly, usually the fourth Tuesday evening, 5:30 to 7:30 PM
default_venue: KPMG, 4655 Executive Dr (UTC)
cost_notes: Free; RSVP on Meetup, cancellations requested by noon the day before.
cpe_notes: Not stated; self report for CCSK, CISSP, CISA.
notes: Meetup group has 1,200 members, organizers include Lito M. 2026 events fell on June 23, July 28, August 25, September 24 and October 27 (all Tuesdays, mostly fourth Tuesday; September 24 was a Thursday). Meetup iCal feed works. The CSA chapter page on cloudsecurityalliance.org has only a contact form and no event listing. A separate CSA SoCal Meetup group (meetup.com/CSA-SoCal) is Los Angeles based. Co-organizer of San Diego CyberCon.

name: San Diego Cyber Group
description: Social meetup for people who work in or study cybersecurity, co-hosted by David Spark of the CISO Series podcast. Monthly Mission Valley gathering with sponsored food and drink, games and a guided discussion, plus a North County satellite meetup in Vista.
usual_cadence_text: Monthly main meetup in Mission Valley, typically a Wednesday evening 6:00 to 8:00 PM near month end; North County satellite roughly monthly on a Tuesday 5:00 to 7:00 PM
default_venue: Novo Brazil Brewing, 1640 Camino Del Rio N Suite 341 (Mission Valley); North County at The Lost Abbey, Vista (formerly Eppig Brewing Vista)
cost_notes: Free; food and drink for the first 60 to 80 attendees courtesy of a rotating sponsor (ThreatLocker, F5, Hack the Box have sponsored).
notes: 2,851 members, 52 past events, organizer David Spark. Attendance at the main event is restricted to cybersecurity practitioners and students. Meetup iCal feed verified working. Next events: Wed Oct 28, 2026 Mission Valley; Tue Nov 10, 2026 Vista. The last Wednesday rule is approximate (Feb 26 2025, May 28 2025, Oct 28 2026 all fit).

name: BSides San Diego
description: Volunteer run 501(c)(3) community security conference with talks, trainings, villages, a CTF, badge challenge and Hacker Jeopardy. Held annually in spring on the San Diego State University campus.
usual_cadence_text: Annual, one Saturday in late March or early April
default_venue: San Diego State University, 6075 Aztec Circle Dr (College Area); after party at Aztec Lanes
cost_notes: Suggested donation tiers through SimpleTix; Patron tier covers full cost of the event. Speaking is free and includes a pass.
notes: 2026 edition was Saturday April 4, 2026 at SDSU. 2027 edition is March 27, 2027 with CFP on Sessionize closing December 20, 2026. Also on Bluesky (bsidessd.bsky.social). Tickets via SimpleTix, not Eventbrite. Co-host of the SD ISSA year end mixer.

name: Cyber Center of Excellence
description: San Diego nonprofit that convenes business, academia and government to grow the regional cyber economy and workforce. Co-hosts the quarterly Cyber Trends panel with the San Diego Business Journal, the annual Cybersecurity Stewardship Awards, the Gold Coast cyber track with NDIA, and aggregates regional cyber events.
usual_cadence_text: Quarterly Cyber Trends panel plus several annual signature events; the news and events page also lists partner events
default_venue: Varies; office at 451 A Street Suite 500 (Downtown)
cost_notes: Varies; many CCOE convened events are free or invitation based.
notes: Best regional aggregator page: sdccoe.org/news-and-events lists upcoming partner events (Techno Security, Tech San Diego, SD Cyber Group, FutureCon). Founding partner of the San Diego Cyber Clinic with CSUSM, SDSU and National University. Publishes the Cyber Insiders podcast and a quarterly newsletter. CEO Lisa Easterly (lisa.easterly@sdccoe.org appears in a City newsletter). Co-organizer of San Diego CyberCon.

name: WiCyS San Diego Affiliate
description: Local affiliate of Women in CyberSecurity offering mentorship, workshops and networking for women in the field. Hosts quarterly networking brunches, an annual Cyber Career Day, Friendsgiving, and a holiday meetup, and cross lists partner chapter meetings on its calendar.
usual_cadence_text: Quarterly affiliate meetups plus an annual Cyber Career Day in April; irregular otherwise
default_venue: Varies; Cyber Career Day 2026 at Palomar College, San Marcos; brunches at casual restaurants
cost_notes: Free for affiliate events.
notes: Own WordPress site with The Events Calendar plugin; the iCal export URL returned empty during research so treat the feed as unverified. Calendar cross lists ISC2 SD and DEF CON 858 meetings, which is useful for discovery. Leaders: Tricia McMahon (president), Veronica Rauch (programs). Also on wicys.org as an organizer page and on Discord. No upcoming events were listed as of October 17, 2026. Co-organizer of San Diego CyberCon.

name: SDSU Cybersecurity Center for Research and Education
description: San Diego State University's cybersecurity program office and research center. Hosts occasional webinars and talks, partners in the San Diego Cyber Clinic, and the campus is the home venue for BSides San Diego.
usual_cadence_text: Irregular
default_venue: SDSU campus (College Area)
cost_notes: Generally free.
notes: No dedicated events feed; news page posts irregularly. The university wide calendar is sdsu.edu/events-calendar. Contact via cyber.sdsu.edu/contact. SDSU faculty regularly appear in the SDBJ Cybersecurity Stewardship Awards.

name: ACM Cyber at UC San Diego
description: UC San Diego's student cybersecurity organization, part of ACM at UCSD. Runs workshops, socials and lockpicking nights during the academic year and organizes the annual San Diego CTF, an online jeopardy style competition open worldwide each spring.
usual_cadence_text: Weekly to biweekly campus events during the academic year; annual San Diego CTF in May
default_venue: UC San Diego campus (La Jolla), often the SME building
cost_notes: Free; no membership fee.
notes: San Diego CTF 2025 ran May 9 to 11 online (ctf.sdc.tf, listed on CTFtime). Primary contact channel is Discord (acmurl.com/cyber-discord). Upcoming: Lock In for Lockpicking, Wed Oct 21, 2026.

name: CSUSM Cybersecurity Education Hub and Cybersecurity Club
description: Cal State San Marcos cybersecurity resource hub for an NSA designated Center of Academic Excellence in Cyber Defense. The student Cybersecurity Club meets weekly during the school year with industry speakers and NCL practice, and the campus runs an annual student CTF.
usual_cadence_text: Weekly club meetings during the academic year; annual CTF
default_venue: CSUSM campus, San Marcos
cost_notes: Free.
notes: Student focused; club meeting day and time not published on the hub page. Founding partner of the San Diego Cyber Clinic. WiCyS SD held its 2026 Cyber Career Day at nearby Palomar College.

name: San Diego Cyber Clinic
description: Google.org funded cybersecurity clinic founded by Cal State San Marcos, SDSU, National University and CCOE that provides free security services to small businesses while training students. Holds an annual anniversary community event each October.
usual_cadence_text: Annual anniversary celebration in mid October
default_venue: Snapdragon Stadium, Cox Business Suite (Mission Valley)
cost_notes: Free, invitation and RSVP based.
notes: No standalone website found; news lives on nu.edu, sdccoe.org and the City Cyber Lab newsletter. First anniversary was Wed Oct 15, 2025 at Snapdragon Stadium; CCOE referenced a Year Two celebration in 2026. National University's Center for Cybersecurity is the NU participant.

name: FutureCon San Diego Cybersecurity Conference
description: One day vendor sponsored cybersecurity conference for CISOs and security leaders, with a keynote, CISO panel, sponsor expo and happy hour. The San Diego stop is hybrid and carries up to 10 CPE credits.
usual_cadence_text: Annual, typically early November
default_venue: San Diego Marriott Mission Valley, 8757 Rio San Diego Dr (Mission Valley)
cost_notes: $50 afternoon pass, $100 early bird in person or virtual per GovEvents; free passes often available through partner chapters (SD ISSA code ISSASD).
cpe_notes: Up to 10 CPE credits, self reported to ISC2 or ISACA.
notes: 2026 date is Thursday November 5, 2026. ISACA San Diego and SD ISSA list it as a partner event. Organizer is FutureCon Events, St. Louis.

name: The Official Cybersecurity Summit San Diego
description: CyberRisk Alliance produced executive cybersecurity summit with panels, keynotes and a sponsor hall, held twice a year in San Diego. Includes catered breakfast, lunch and a closing reception.
usual_cadence_text: Twice a year, typically February and September
default_venue: Marriott Marquis San Diego Marina, 333 W Harbor Dr (Downtown Marina)
cost_notes: $250 standard admission; free passes commonly distributed through partner groups (WISP code CSS26-WISP) and ISACA.
cpe_notes: Up to 8 CPE or CEU credits per the organizer.
notes: 2026 editions: February 5 and September 10. 2027: February 18, 2027 at the Marriott Marquis. Registration runs on Swoogo (cyberriskalliance.swoogo.com). Jerry spoke on the 2026 AI panel.

name: Data Connectors Cybersecurity Conference
description: Long running vendor driven cybersecurity conference series that has historically run a one day San Diego Cybersecurity Conference. Executive level program with sponsor exhibits and CPE.
usual_cadence_text: Irregular; no 2026 or 2027 San Diego date verified
cost_notes: Historically free or low cost for practitioners; unverified for current events.
notes: dataconnectors.com now redirects to a Substack newsletter and the Eventbrite organizer page showed no upcoming San Diego events. Treat as dormant for San Diego until a listing appears. Several aggregator listings titled 'San Diego Cybersecurity Conference' now point to FutureCon instead.

name: Evanta Southern California CISO Community
description: Gartner owned invitation only executive community for CISOs. San Diego security leaders are served by the Southern California CISO Executive Summit, held annually in the Los Angeles and Orange County area, plus a San Diego community page that had no scheduled programs.
usual_cadence_text: Annual Southern California CISO Executive Summit, late fall or spring; San Diego specific programs not currently scheduled
default_venue: 2026: The Waterfront Beach Resort (Huntington Beach); 2027: Marriott Long Beach Downtown
cost_notes: No fee for qualified executives; attendance is vetted.
notes: Eligibility is C-level at organizations with $500M+ revenue or 1,000+ public sector employees. 2026 SoCal summit: November 18, 2026. 2027 SoCal summit: May 12, 2027. The evanta.com/ciso/san-diego page exists but listed no upcoming events.

name: CyberRisk Collaborative (formerly Cybersecurity Collaborative)
description: Member only peer council for CISOs and their direct reports, part of CyberRisk Alliance. Runs regional CISO dinners and leadership exchanges in major metros.
usual_cadence_text: Irregular; no San Diego chapter or event found
cost_notes: Paid membership tiers; events are member only.
notes: Cybersecurity Collaborative was acquired by CyberRisk Alliance in 2019 and rebranded; cyberleadersunite.com redirects to cyberriskcollaborative.com. The only California community listed is Bay Area. Included for completeness; low priority for a San Diego calendar.

name: San Diego CISO Roundtable
description: Invitation only peer group of more than 100 regional security leaders founded in 2007. Meets quarterly under strict confidentiality to share threat intelligence and mentor newer CISOs; vendors and outside guests are generally not admitted.
usual_cadence_text: Quarterly, members only
cost_notes: Members only; no public pricing.
notes: Listed by the City of San Diego Cyber Lab as a regional resource. Board includes Macy Dennis (founder), Terrence Weekes (chair), Matt Stamper. Not a public calendar source but worth a seed row for CISO level readers. This may be what was meant by 'SD Cyber Security Council'; no organization by that exact name was found.

name: San Diego CyberCon
description: Community organized nonprofit regional conference run jointly by 14 local chapters including ISACA SD, ISSA SD, ISC2 SD, CSA SD, OWASP OC, WiCyS SD and CCOE. Executive and deep tech tracks, a CXO and speaker dinner, and a Toys for Tots drive; surplus funds go to regional cyber education.
usual_cadence_text: Annual, mid November
default_venue: Marriott Marquis San Diego Marina, 333 W Harbor Dr (Downtown Marina)
cost_notes: 2026 tickets on Zeffy: $195 full pass, $175 single track with lunch, $150 single track or active military or student full pass, $75 student track; 50 percent off through chapter codes such as SDCC26-ISSA50. Registration is a tax deductible donation.
cpe_notes: Up to 9 CPE; ISC2 records CPE for attendees who check in at the ISC2 table.
notes: 2026 edition is Friday November 13, 2026, 8 AM to 6 PM. Ticketing on Zeffy, not Eventbrite. Sponsorship at sponsorship@sdcybercon.org. First year verified as 2026; treat 'annual' as the stated intent.

name: San Diego Tech Scene
description: Community run aggregator calendar of San Diego tech, startup and user group events dating to 2009. Lists OWASP SD, DEF CON 858 and San Diego Cyber Group meetings alongside general tech events, and produces the annual March Mingle and Mini Mingle networking nights.
usual_cadence_text: Continuous aggregator; March Mingle annually in March, Mini Mingle mid year
default_venue: Mingles at Aero Club Bar, 3365 India St (Middletown)
cost_notes: Aggregated events vary; Mini Mingle 2026 tickets were listed at $0.
notes: WordPress site using The Events Calendar; the iCal export URL did not load during research so the feed is unverified. Also runs a Luma calendar (luma.com/calendar/cal-hCkcRgqEUK2UUbo) with a working iCal feed, used for the Mingles. Useful as a secondary discovery source for security meetups.

name: The Social Coyote
description: Weekly San Diego newsletter by Jonah Peake curating tech and entrepreneurship events by day, selected from more than a thousand listings a month. Mostly startup and product events with occasional security or AI items.
usual_cadence_text: Weekly newsletter
cost_notes: Free with a paid tier; part of each issue is behind a subscription wall.
notes: Published on beehiiv; thesocialcoyote.beehiiv.com redirects to howl.thesocialcoyote.com. Has a Discord community (Enter The Den). No structured feed beyond the newsletter and beehiiv RSS. Useful for cross checking community events, not a primary security source.

name: Startup San Diego
description: 501(c)(3) that supports the San Diego startup ecosystem. Runs 1st Mondays networking panels, Last Fridays co-working, and San Diego Startup Week each November, which in 2026 included a Cybersecurity for Startups session and AI office hours.
usual_cadence_text: 1st Mondays quarterly networking event; Last Fridays monthly co-working; Startup Week annually in early November
default_venue: 1st Mondays at Cooley LLP, 10265 Science Center Dr (Torrey Pines); Last Fridays at Downtown Works Mission Valley
cost_notes: 1st Mondays ticketed on Eventbrite with free food and drink; Startup Week 2026 day pass $99, week pass $229.
notes: Events calendar is WordPress The Events Calendar with a working iCal subscription (webcal://startupsd.org/?post_type=tribe_events&ical=1&eventDisplay=list). Eventbrite organizer id 9236362099. Startup Week Nov 2 to 6, 2026 across Carlsbad, Carmel Mountain, UCSD, Cooley and SDSU. Tangential to security; include for AI and startup security sessions.

name: San Diego AI Developers Group (AICamp)
description: AICamp affiliated Meetup for AI developers in San Diego with tech talks, workshops and code labs, many held online. Recent series included an agent security session with Google.
usual_cadence_text: Frequent, several events a month, often online and in series; irregular pattern
default_venue: Mostly online; in person venues vary
cost_notes: Free.
notes: 2,853 members, 395 past events, organizer April. Security content is occasional (AI Deep Dive with Google Ep 4: Agents Security). Meetup iCal feed available at the standard /events/ical/ path (not individually verified).

name: AI Tinkerers San Diego
description: San Diego chapter of the global AI Tinkerers builder network. Demo focused meetups and an occasional hackathon for people building with LLMs and agents.
usual_cadence_text: Irregular, roughly every one to three months, Thursday evenings
default_venue: Varies; one event at Amazon SAN13, 10300 Campus Point Dr (University City)
cost_notes: Free.
notes: Events are hosted on the aitinkerers.org platform with a small mirror Meetup group (38 members). Next event: GTM Engineering Meetup, Thu Oct 29, 2026. No security focus; include as an AI governance adjacent community.

name: DEF CON Group San Diego (DC858 / DC619)
description: San Diego's DEF CON group, a gathering point for people interested in hacking and alternate uses of technology. Monthly informal meeting with free pizza and project and tech discussion.
usual_cadence_text: Monthly, second Wednesday, 6:00 to 8:00 PM
default_venue: Round Table Pizza, upstairs dining area, 16761 Bernardo Center Dr (Rancho Bernardo)
cost_notes: Free, pizza provided.
notes: Second Wednesday inferred from June 11, 2025, September 10, 2025, December 8, 2021 and June 9, 2021 meetings. Discord invite discord.gg/2RQxEFwNJS, X @DCG858, Facebook DC858. Meetings are cross listed on the City of San Diego events calendar, WiCyS SD and SD Tech Scene; the group's own site did not render a calendar. Co-host of SD ISSA mixers.

name: SANS Institute San Diego Training Events
description: SANS runs two multi day training events in San Diego each year: a winter event in La Jolla (CyberCon or Surge) and the flagship SANS Security West in May downtown, with evening community talks and NetWars tournaments.
usual_cadence_text: Twice a year: late February in La Jolla and mid May downtown, each six days
default_venue: Security West at Hilton San Diego Bayfront, 1 Park Blvd (Downtown); winter event at San Diego Marriott La Jolla, 4240 La Jolla Village Dr
cost_notes: Courses $5,250 to $9,230 plus $999 GIAC exam; evening community talks and NetWars are often free to registered attendees.
cpe_notes: 18 to 51 CPE per course toward GIAC and other certifications.
notes: 2026: SANS CyberCon San Diego Feb 23 to 28 (La Jolla), SANS Security West May 11 to 16 (downtown). 2027: Security West May 10 to 15, 2027 at Hilton Bayfront. Early bird $900 off by Oct 21, 2026. Free community night talks are not always listed publicly in advance.

name: San Diego Regional Economic Development Corporation
description: Regional economic development nonprofit that publishes research on the San Diego cyber cluster with CCOE and hosts periodic trade, investment and industry events.
usual_cadence_text: Irregular; a few events per quarter, mostly economic development topics
cost_notes: Varies.
notes: Cyber content is occasional (Cybersecurity in the San Diego Region report). Upcoming: Go Global 2030 Nov 17, 2026. Weekly Good News of the Week blog. Low priority for a security calendar.

name: Connect Foundation (Connect San Diego)
description: Innovation accelerator for San Diego tech and life science startups. Runs Connect Forward, the Summer Social Cool Companies showcase, IDEA Week, an invite only Venture Summit, and recurring SBIR and accounting office hours.
usual_cadence_text: Monthly office hours plus several annual signature events; IDEA Week in October
default_venue: UCSD Park & Market, 1100 Market St (East Village); Summer Social at Coastal Roots Farm (Encinitas)
cost_notes: Varies; office hours free.
notes: Events calendar is on Luma (luma.com/connect-sd) and accepts community submissions through Airtable. Cyber content is incidental. Formerly known for the Most Innovative New Product awards.

name: CyberTECH Network (CyberHive)
description: Downtown San Diego incubator and coworking network founded by Darin Andersen that launched the CyberHive security startup incubator, the CyberCalifornia initiative and the Smart and Safe Cities symposium series, historically known for the annual CyberTini social.
usual_cadence_text: Claims more than 60 events a year, but the public events page was empty; treat as irregular
default_venue: 1855 First Avenue Suite 103 (Bankers Hill)
cost_notes: Smart and Safe Cities symposium events listed as free on Eventbrite.
notes: Events page showed no current listings and the latest news items were from 2020, so activity level is uncertain. Registration historically through Eventbrite. The LinkedIn link is a group, not a company page.

name: AFCEA San Diego Chapter
description: Defense C4I and cyber industry chapter serving Navy, Marine Corps and defense contractor communities. Hosts periodic Tech Talks, the annual NAML conference in spring, the Mission Systems Symposium and golf tournament in September, an Emerging Leaders program and a December holiday fundraiser.
usual_cadence_text: Several signature events a year plus occasional Tech Talks; NAML annually in March or April, Mission Systems Symposium annually in September
default_venue: NAML 2027 at Hyatt Regency La Jolla; other venues vary
cost_notes: Varies; many events are paid with member and government rates.
notes: AFCEA West, the large February conference at the San Diego Convention Center, is run by AFCEA International and USNI, not the chapter. Tech Talk held Oct 21, 2026; next listed as TBA. NAML 2027 April 12 to 15 (unclassified days April 12 to 13).

name: NDIA San Diego Chapter
description: National Defense Industrial Association chapter for the San Diego defense industry. Presents the annual Department of the Navy Gold Coast small business procurement event, whose cyber track and CMMC Academy are co-hosted with CCOE, plus a Fall Forum, monthly small business meetings and executive networking forums.
usual_cadence_text: Monthly small business and networking meetings; Gold Coast annually in August; Fall Forum in November
default_venue: Varies: Fall Forum at Catamaran Resort (Pacific Beach); Gold Coast at San Diego Convention Center
cost_notes: Fall Forum 2026 industry $499 early bird to $599; holiday party $35; Gold Coast cyber track free.
notes: Events site uses The Events Calendar with a working iCal feed: https://www.ndia-sd.org/events/list/?ical=1 (webcal://www.ndia-sd.org/?post_type=tribe_events&ical=1&eventDisplay=list). Upcoming: Fall Forum Nov 17 to 18, 2026; holiday membership meeting Dec 17, 2026; NIWC PAC Executive Networking Forum Jan 13, 2027. Gold Coast cyber track and CMMC Academy was Aug 17, 2026. Membership chair Susan Couch.

name: San Diego Regional Cyber Lab (City of San Diego)
description: City of San Diego initiative providing a regional cyber hub, tools and a resource directory for local governments and partners. Runs quarterly technical and executive stakeholder committee meetings, a summer cyber internship with SDCOE, and curates a regional events list and quarterly newsletter.
usual_cadence_text: Quarterly stakeholder committee meetings and a quarterly newsletter; events page lists third party regional events
default_venue: 1200 Third Ave 18th Floor (Downtown Civic Core)
cost_notes: Free; stakeholder meetings are for member organizations.
notes: The events page and newsletter are useful aggregation sources: they list SANS, BSides, DEF CON 858, OWASP and ISC2 SD events, and the resources page lists regional organizations including the San Diego CISO Roundtable. The City's main event calendar (sandiego.gov/event/...) also carries DC858 meetings.

name: San Diego Cyber Security for Control Systems ((CS)2AI)
description: San Diego node of the Control System Cyber Security Association International for OT, ICS, SCADA and industrial IoT security. Nearly all events are the association's online seminars; in person San Diego gatherings are planned once local interest grows.
usual_cadence_text: Roughly weekly to biweekly online seminars, Wednesdays at 10:00 AM Pacific; no regular in person meeting
default_venue: Online (Zoom)
cost_notes: Free online seminars; sponsored by KPMG, Fortinet and others.
cpe_notes: Not stated; (CS)2AI seminars are generally self reported.
